ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure is a food chain schematic diagram from left to right, with the sun on the left and a plant-like organism labeled Organism A; an arrow points from Organism A to Organism B; another arrow points from Organism B to a fish labeled Organism C; and another arrow points from Organism C to a bird labeled Organism D. Reasoning: The arrows indicate the transfer of food or energy along the food chain, and Organism C directly depends on/preys on Organism B. If Organism B increases, the food available to Organism C increases, therefore Organism C will increase.
